description: This is a test class for the FormService component in the OpenMRS medical record system. It contains unit tests for creating, updating, deleting, duplicating, and retrieving forms, form fields, and form resources, as well as handling UUIDs and locking-related behaviors. The file relies heavily on JUnit 5 for testing and interacts with the OpenMRS API services and domain objects.
